MainForm.buttonConnect.ToolTip: Links the application to the specified ID with set presence.
MainForm.buttonDisconnect.ToolTip: Disconnects the app from Discord. Please note that it might take a while.
MainForm.labelButton1.ToolTip: First of the two buttons that shows up under your status in your profile popup and on the right side in the full profile.
MainForm.labelButton1URL.ToolTip: URL the button will take user to upon clicking.
MainForm.labelButton2.ToolTip: Second button, which appears right under the first button, or instead of it, if the first one isn't set.
MainForm.labelButton2URL.ToolTip: URL the button will take user to upon clicking.
MainForm.labelDetailsURL.ToolTip: A link that will open when user clicks on Details text.
MainForm.labelDisplay.ToolTip: Controls which field is displayed in the user's status text in the member list.
MainForm.labelID.ToolTip: ID of the application from Discord Developers site.
MainForm.labelLarge.ToolTip: Image that shows left to the text set above.
MainForm.labelLargeKey.ToolTip: Name of the asset for large image or an image URL.
MainForm.labelLargeText.ToolTip: Text displayed when hovering the large image.
MainForm.labelLargeURL.ToolTip: A link that will open when user clicks on large image.
MainForm.labelParty.ToolTip:
Amount of players in the current party that shows next to State field.
To take effect, both fields should be more than 0.
MainForm.labelSmall.ToolTip: Image that shows up in the down right corner of large image.
MainForm.labelSmallKey.ToolTip: Name of the asset for small image or an image URL.
MainForm.labelSmallText.ToolTip: Text displayed when hovering the small image.
MainForm.labelSmallURL.ToolTip: A link that will open when user clicks on small image.
MainForm.labelStateURL.ToolTip: A link that will open when user clicks on State text.
MainForm.labelTimestamp.ToolTip:
Sets up timestamp for the status, which shows up under all the text above.
Status timers have 24 hour limit, meaning that after 24 hours time will go back to 0:00.
MainForm.labelType.ToolTip: Type of activity for the presence.
MainForm.radioButtonCustom.ToolTip: Shows how much time has passed since or is remaining to the date set below.
MainForm.radioButtonLastConnection.ToolT: Shows how much time has passed since you last connected.
MainForm.radioButtonLocalTime.ToolTip: Shows your current time in 24-hour format.
MainForm.radioButtonPresence.ToolTip: Shows how much time has passed since you last connected or updated the presence.
MainForm.radioButtonStartTime.ToolTip: Shows time since the app was started.
MainForm.trayIcon.BalloonTipText: Double click on the icon to show it again, or right-click to quit.
MainForm.trayIcon.BalloonTipTitle: The app will run in the tray.
